summary: Landscaped corner at a signalised junction; clearway and no room to stop.
reasons: Clearway tow away on Moggill Road

drivers.seclusion: Open to the junction and the road; buildings 13-15 m away are shops or a dental practice.
drivers.access_and_room: Short 11 m grassed corner with trees and a footpath; no kerb space for a van clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial and signals right beside it.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles on this corner; clearway Mon-Sat 4-7pm with tow away and 2P parking on Jackson Street.

sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the stretch; open to the south.
cannot_judge: Kerbside restrictions on Jackson Street overnight
